author: Unity
description:
An Awaitable class is a wrapper around an asynchronous task that allows your method to pause and automatically continue when that task finishes. In this video, we give you an introduction to Unity's awaitable system, including its core concepts and examples of how you can implement it in your projects while avoiding common pitfalls.

Awaitable class on documentation:
https://on.unity.com/AwaitablesManual

Find more free Unity learn resources:
https://on.unity.com/learn

#gamedev #unity3d #unitylearn
title: Getting Started with Awaitables

author: Unity
description:
Scripts looking a little chaotic in the Inspector window? Join Andreas and Antonio from Sirenix as we take a closer look at Odin, a Unity Verified Solution that helps teams create better custom inspectors, validate data, and streamline production workflows. We’ll cover Odin Inspector and Validator, and spotlight the new Visual Inspector, a no-code way to customize your scripts and make the Unity Editor easier for everyone on your team to use.

🔗 Find out more about Odin here: https://odininspector.com/
title: Asset Showcase: Odin
